description: This is a PHP class file defining the EmployeeGender display field for the HRM reporting system. It extends a combined display field and specifies the DTO class, data fields, and entity aliases used for displaying employee gender information in reports.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: Represents a display field for employee gender information within the HRM reporting system. Extends CombinedDisplayField and overrides methods to specify DTO class, data fields, and entity aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for this display field, which is 'Dto\EmployeeGender'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields relevant to this display, specifically 'employee.gender'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of aliases used for the entities involved, in this case ['employee'].
